newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa may consider raising 96/97 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Degussa may consider raising 96/97 dividend.

text.p: German chemicals and metals group Degussa AG on Friday held out the hope that it may raise its dividend payout for the 1996/1997 business year, if profits rise as expected.
"If profits rise at the pace we expect, the we will think positively about the topic of a dividend," Degussa management board chairman Uwe-Ernst Bufe told the group's annual shareholder meeting.
He declined to comment more specifically however.
For the 1995/1996 business year, Degussa plans to pay a 13 mark dividend, up from 12.50 marks in the previous year.
